K6 is MISSING because there is no mention of the framework-driven development strategy, reusable codebases, or retrofitting features across titles, which are core components of this criterion. The overall coverage is strong, but the absence of K6—a HIGH importance item—prevents the summary from achieving a perfect score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically support each other without contradictions. The performance improvements (revenue, EBITDA, profit) are consistently explained by strategic decisions (marketing investment, focus on core titles). The margin changes are logically connected to stated causes (higher marketing spend, advertising optimization). The summary flows chronologically and thematically, with clear cause-effect relationships throughout. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all numerical changes are contextualized with explanations. The summary forms a coherent narrative from overall performance to specific drivers and forward guidance.
